excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin. Wears a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, white skirt and light blue pumps.
excavation_context.stage: Air-Scribing Fine Mudstone Matrix around a Horned Dinosaur Skull

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 sits at her lab workbench under focused overhead task lighting, guiding a thin pneumatic air-scribe tool across a block of soft yellowish-grey mudstone matrix. The fine sedimentary rock flakes away neatly, slowly revealing the large, curved brow horn and bony frill of a Triceratops skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
